messages:
maya: kicking off canary for release v2.13.0 -> eu-west-1, plan: 5% -> 25% over 30m. preflight checks running.
deploy-bot: rollout started: v2.13.0 canary=5% started at 2026-03-20T10:12Z. monitor: /dash/slo/canary-v2.13.0
olivia: tiny reminder — SLO baseline p95=78ms, error budget healthy before rollout. link: https://dash.redwood/slo/embed-service
samir: seeing a small uptick in 5xx on embed-service around 10:16, ~12 errors in 2min. not sure if tied to canary.
diego: looks like GPU-worker tail latency spiked too, p99 from 420ms -> 920ms at 10:17. might be cold-starts for a few pods.
maya: copying logs, thanks. can we check route health and model variant pinning?
jen: recommend pausing progression at 5% until we confirm. can we pin traffic to model v1.4 (non-quantized) for this roll?
samir: quick query I ran: 
```
SELECT count(*) FROM http_errors WHERE service='embed-service' AND ts >= '2026-03-20T10:15' GROUP BY 1m;
```
shows the 10:16 minute spike.
ops-bot: alert: canary_p95_increase detected for embed-service, p95 +42% vs baseline. threshold breach=30%. auto-pause not enabled.
diego: if we pin model variant to v1.4 it may reduce KV cache misses; I can flip it on the canary nodes.
maya: do it, but keep the canary traffic at 5% and don't advance until we validate for 10m. inform on-call if we see more errors.
deploy-bot: updated canary config: model_pin=v1.4 applied to canary nodes at 10:20Z.
olivia: after pin, p95 trending down to 85ms at 10:24, errors reduced to 2 in the last 5m.
jen: still 👍 hold on wider rollout. recommend a 30m soak and then a new health-check pass.
samir: filing a quick post-check note in the release doc: https://docs.redwood/releases/v2.13.0/notes — added error timeline.
maya: ok paused at 5% and pinned. will wait for soak window and run the extended SLO dashboard at +30m. follow-up: if errors stay <= baseline +10% we proceed; otherwise rollback. :thumbsup:
